This is a verifiable defect introduced/exposed by the change.

adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff around line 554 in EventManager.ts, when merging bookings (newBookingId case), the code uses `find` to get only the first calendar reference: `const oldCalendarEvent = booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes('_calendar'))`. However, the rest of the code has been refactored to handle multiple calendar references (using `filter` instead of `find` for calendarReference). This means when rescheduling/merging, only the first old calendar event gets deleted while other collective-host calendar events remain orphaned. This is inconsistent with the multi-calendar handling pattern established elsewhere in the same function.
